relays.name: Lunar Pathfinder
relays.status: Not launched; "due 2027" on Blue Ghost Mission 2
relays.label: indicative

source.title: SSTL Lunar Pathfinder Service Guide, section 3.4.3 (footer V004, file V2-2)
source.quote: these parameters are indicative and may be subject to change as the design progresses and when the launch date is set

relays.assumptions: The frame is assumed to be Earth-Moon axes, as in AAS 25-758. RAAN and mean anomaly are swept because the guide fixes no epoch or frame for them. Operational ephemeris goes to customers only (Kiteworks).

relays.name: Intuitive Machines Lunar Data Network
relays.status: Not launched; first satellite (Altus-1) on IM-3, early 2027
relays.label: preliminary design

source.title: Brack et al., AAS 25-758, Preliminary Design of the Lunar Data Network Constellation, Tables 2 and 3

relays.state_frame: Moon-centred ICRF (Table 3); treated as SPICE J2000
relays.elements_frame: Moon-centred Earth-Moon axes at the epoch, inertial velocity (Table 2; established by comparison with Table 3, see validation/relay-orbits.md)
known_issues: LDN-1 disagrees between the paper's tables: Table 3 gives radius 3631.8 km, Table 2 gives 3869.3 km. The other four agree within 5 km. Table 3 is used.
Table 2 RAAN differs from Table 3 by a constant 241.49 deg for all five, so its zero point is unstated. Table 3 is used for absolute placement.
The paper says LDN-1's plane and phase are unconstrained, so LDN-1 alone is illustrative.
